title: League of Football
description: Play League of Football, a fast-paced 2D soccer game! Pick your team, master fireball shots and teleport tricks, and battle through Quick Match, Tournament and 2-player modes. Score goals, win the championship and become a football legend. Easy to learn, hard to master — perfect for quick matches or full tournaments.
instructions: Player 1 WASD Arrow keys to move shoot and slide tackle Player 2 Arrow keys On mobile use on-screen buttons Tap to kick hold to charge powerful shots

title: SUPER SAVING FOOTBALL
description: Get ready for Super Saving Football, the ultimate experience that blends the passion of the beautiful game with classic 2D platforming action! The world of football is in danger, and only you can save it from the clutches of dark creatures. What makes Super Saving Football a unique adventure? Classic Platforming Action: Jump, run, and slide through fantastical worlds.jj If you love a challenge that tests your jumping and precision, this is the game for you! Ball Skills: Your best weapon is the ball! Use it to knock out enemies, activate secret mechanisms, and overcome impossible obstacles with special shots.
instructions: Simple yet deep controls arrows movement space jump Z dash X shoot Classic platforming action precise jumps and slides Unique boss battles use the ball dashes and jumps to dodge attacks Colorful and varied worlds from enchanted stadium

title: Soccer Trainer
description: Soccer Trainer is a casual football game that tests your reaction and hand speed Players can make a very interesting football competition game on their mobile phones. Players can experience very exciting football,
instructions: You can now play freely on your mobile phone train two players with two fingers and let them pass through various obstacles It will take you into a new model of the football world

title: Ultra Kick: Goal Crazy
description: Ultra Kick is the ultimate penalty shootout experience! Step up to the spot, read the goalkeeper, and fire into the top corners. Master 4 deadly shot types — normal, curve ball, power blast, and the cheeky chip shot. Chain goals for hat-trick bonuses, upgrade your skills in the Transfer Market, and face 3 legendary boss goalkeepers: The Wall, Lightning Hands, and the mysterious Oracle. Three difficulty modes. One question: can you score?
instructions: Aim with the moving cursor charge your power and shoot Chain goals for bonuses use 4 shot types and defeat legendary boss goalkeepers to win
